metadata.title: Clicked like I’m allergic to aiming and somehow snagged a weird 1 kill?! Valorant what?!
metadata.description:
Me: spazzing like I found the panic button
Enemy: probably questioning their life choices
Valorant just handed me a kill nobody asked for
Did this really just happen? No clue!

Tap if your panic aim ever surprises even YOU!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
